scope: lineage-only correction at absorption of inherited V or T; within-life unchanged AM3

literalDefinition.territory: Θ_t = distinct zones from z[max(0,t-24)] through z[t-1], including initial z0 at t0
literalDefinition.tStar: last t in search window with z[t+1] not in Θ_t; fallback t_a−1
literalDefinition.terminalV: once per distinct excursion edge: V←V+(−1−V)/8; all other pending final24 abolition o″ neutral 0
literalDefinition.terminalT: once per distinct excursion edge: T←T+(−1−T)/8; others unmarked

unitTests: circuit then 1→2→4→5 must mark 3 pitward gates once; loop untouched
with zone2 in territory, final departure 2→4 must mark 2→4 and 4→5
T and V terminal marks same for each test
successor loop V(1→8)=0, same uncued exit as B

recognizedConflict.reason: For first arrival at terminal zone5, z[t_a]=5 is never in Θ_[t_a−1]. Thus literal last departure t*=t_a−1 always, and only 4→5 marked, contradicting mandatory unit tests 1,2. Any change requires prospective operator-signed correction.

provenance.designRule: abolition belongs to the line of flight that does not return, not to the territory it left
